title: An enterprise investigation agent, from problem to production
summary: Ravikanth took an enterprise SRE investigation agent from thesis to production, owning problem definition, prototype, architecture, engineering, integration, evaluation, governance, rollout, and daily operation.

sections.label: Operator problem
sections.text: Production failures cross services and ownership boundaries. Operators need to connect current telemetry with ownership, dependencies, recent changes, and the affected customer journey before deciding what to do.

sections.label: Personal ownership
sections.text: I carried the investigation agent from problem definition and prototype through architecture, engineering, enterprise integration, evaluation, governance, rollout, and running it in production.

sections.label: Implementation and tradeoffs
sections.text: I separated deterministic routing, evidence collection, and gate evaluation from model reasoning. Governed interfaces connect telemetry and enterprise workflows; bounded tool use, evidence references, and human review keep recommendations inspectable.

sections.label: Evaluation and operation
sections.text: My published experience includes evaluation workflows for root-cause analysis, operational usefulness, and regression testing, plus instrumentation for tool calls, orchestration paths, latency, and model behavior. The public Ask checks are a separate implementation that visitors can inspect.

sections.label: Stakeholders and rollout
sections.text: The delivery scope included governance, rollout, and daily operation. I also authored executive technical memos and delivered architecture enablement sessions for operations, platform engineering, and leadership stakeholders. Specific adoption measurements and customer feedback are not published here.

outcomeBoundary: The production AI delivery is stated professional experience. Its adoption, incident-resolution improvements, and production performance measurements are not published on this site. The outcomes below concern earlier identity and automation work, not the investigation agent.
demonstrationBoundary: The Operations Room is a synthetic example, and the public reference architecture is separate from the employer implementation. They demonstrate investigation design and engineering judgment; they do not independently verify private production results.
